audit.whatIsWrong: Full phases[2..6].side read "Skill" on five rows while content win[2..6] read Galio/Galio/Galio/Azir/Azir. Ratings also stayed at 5-6/10 regardless of who the row gave the stage to.
audit.why: Packet levelChart matches the content layer (Galio x5, then Azir x2) and the kit supports it — his engage and his global own the first five stages, Azir's scaling owns the last two.
audit.corrected: Both layers aligned to Galio x5 / Azir x2, ratings moved to match the verdict, and every changed why rewritten.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[2] (Level 3) and whys[4] (Level 6) were both wrong: whys[2] described the global ultimate Galio does not have until 6, and whys[4] argued AZIR's wave clear catching up on a row the content layer gives to GALIO.
audit.why: Hero's Entrance is 180/160/140 with 4000/4750/5500 range and unlocks at 6. Level 3-5 belongs to Justice Punch (11/10/9/8/7, 650) and Shield of Durand (18/17/16/15/14, 275).
audit.corrected: Level 3 restated on Justice Punch, Level 6 on Hero's Entrance, both arguing the side the row actually gives.

audit.whatIsWrong: Winds of War was described as a "shield-and-slow" / "slow-shield combo" in four places. It is neither. breakdown.cooldowns also had no digit.
audit.why: Riot's text: Winds of War (Q, 11/10/9/8/7, 825) fires two windblasts that converge into a tornado dealing damage over time — no shield, no slow. The shield, the slow and the taunt all belong to Shield of Durand (W, 18/17/16/15/14, 275). Attributing W's effects to Q sends the player dodging the wrong ability.
audit.corrected: Q restated as an 825-range damage-over-time tornado; the taunt and shield returned to Shield of Durand; real cooldowns added throughout.

audit.whatIsWrong: Colossal Smash's auto-attack reset was never given as a tell.
audit.why: brief.missingInteractions flags autoreset-burst-tell — his empowered area auto is the wind-up cue, not the ability cast.
audit.corrected: Folded into dontsFull[0].d, which sits under the title "Stand still admiring your soldier DPS".

notes: Largest factual defect on this page: Winds of War (Q) was called a "shield-and-slow"/"slow-shield" zone in four fields. Riot's text gives it two windblasts converging into a damage-over-time tornado — the shield, slow and taunt are all Shield of Durand (W, 275 range, 18-14s). A player dodging the wrong ability is worse than no advice. Second defect: "Conquer the Sands" (mid, spikes[2], whys[4]) — Azir's Q is Conquering Sands; the other four suspectNames are false positives. Third: whys[2] put the global ultimate on the Level 3 row and whys[4] argued Azir's side on a row the chart gives Galio. Report sweep cap respected: only report[0].t and report[1].t rewritten; report[3].t, report[4].t and report[5].t still carry superseded text.
